plain_description: **Find weaknesses in LLM applications before they cause problems.** Scan for issues such as prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, and harmful outputs. Review reports showing which probes found vulnerabilities.
technical_description: garak is a command-line tool for red-teaming and assessing LLM-backed applications. It runs static, dynamic, and adaptive probes against a selected model, then uses detectors to identify undesirable behavior and reports results. The README lists support for Hugging Face, OpenAI, Replicate, AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, REST endpoints, and GGUF models such as llama.cpp.
title: garak, LLM vulnerability scanner
